::: {.callout-note}
## Course Portal: Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics A (4MA1)
Welcome, students! This specialized academic portal provides in-depth resources for the Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Mathematics A (4MA1) curriculum. Here, you will find exhaustive syllabus checklists, revision notes, targeted practice question banks, and official exam information—all mathematically formatted to optimize your learning and help you achieve a Grade 9.
:::

## 1 Course Introduction

<p><strong>Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Mathematics A (4MA1)</strong> is a structured and comprehensive academic curriculum designed to develop mathematical skills, logical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. The syllabus is divided into two tiers of entry: <strong>Foundation Tier</strong> (grades 5–1) and <strong>Higher Tier</strong> (grades 9–4, with grade 3 allowed), offering appropriate routes of assessment for students of different abilities.</p>

**Assessment Objectives (AOs) Weightings:**
* **AO1 (Number and algebra):** 57 - 63%
* **AO2 (Shape, space and measures):** 22 - 28%
* **AO3 (Handling data):** 12 - 18%

### Syllabus Structure

<p>The Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics A syllabus content is categorized into 6 major topics, covering core concepts for all students with extended high-level parts for the Higher Tier:</p>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 1 Numbers and the number system
**1.1** Integers<br/>
**1.2** Fractions<br/>
**1.3** Decimals<br/>
**1.4** Powers and roots<br/>
**1.5** Set language and notation<br/>
**1.6** Percentages<br/>
**1.7** Ratio and proportion<br/>
**1.8** Degree of accuracy<br/>
**1.9** Standard form<br/>
**1.10** Applying number<br/>
**1.11** Electronic calculators<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 2 Equations, formulae and identities
**2.1** Use of symbols<br/>
**2.2** Algebraic manipulation<br/>
**2.3** Expressions and formulae<br/>
**2.4** Linear equations<br/>
**2.5** Proportion (Higher Tier only)<br/>
**2.6** Simultaneous linear equations<br/>
**2.7** Quadratic equations<br/>
**2.8** Inequalities<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 3 Sequences, functions and graphs
**3.1** Sequences<br/>
**3.2** Function notation (Higher Tier only)<br/>
**3.3** Graphs<br/>
**3.4** Calculus (Higher Tier only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 4 Geometry and trigonometry
**4.1** Angles, lines and triangles<br/>
**4.2** Polygons<br/>
**4.3** Symmetry<br/>
**4.4** Measures<br/>
**4.5** Construction<br/>
**4.6** Circle properties<br/>
**4.7** Geometrical reasoning<br/>
**4.8** Trigonometry and Pythagoras' theorem<br/>
**4.9** Mensuration / Mensuration of 2D shapes<br/>
**4.10** 3D shapes and volume<br/>
**4.11** Similarity<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 5 Vectors and transformation geometry
**5.1** Vectors (Higher Tier only)<br/>
**5.2** Transformation geometry<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 6 Statistics and probability
**6.1** Graphical representation of data<br/>
**6.2** Statistical measures<br/>
**6.3** Probability<br/>
:::

### Edexcel IGCSE Mathematics General Past Papers Bank

```{=html}
<div class="card p-3 mb-4 shadow-sm" style="border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); background: var(--bs-card-bg, #ffffff);">
  <div class="card-body p-0">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
      
      <!-- Year Select Dropdown -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 160px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Year:</span>
        <select id="filter-year" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectYearDropdown()" style="max-width: 110px; display: inline-block;">
          <option value="">All Years</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Subject Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Subject:</span>
        <div id="subject-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-subject-btn active" data-subject="" onclick="selectSubject(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-subject-btn" data-subject="4ma" onclick="selectSubject(this)">4MA</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-subject-btn" data-subject="4mb" onclick="selectSubject(this)">4MB</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Tier Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Tier:</span>
        <div id="tier-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-tier-btn active" data-tier="" onclick="selectTier(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-tier-btn" data-tier="h" onclick="selectTier(this)">Higher</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-tier-btn" data-tier="f" onclick="selectTier(this)">Foundation</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Paper Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 flex-grow-1">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Paper:</span>
        <div id="paper-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-paper-btn active" data-paper="" onclick="selectPaper(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="p1" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 1</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="p2" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 2</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="past-papers-table-container">
  <p><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Loading past papers...</p>
</div>

<script>
let pastPapersDb = [];
let currentSelectedYear = '';
let currentSelectedSubject = '';
let currentSelectedTier = '';
let currentSelectedPaper = '';
let currentPage = 1;
const pageSize = 10;
let filteredExams = [];

async function loadPastPapersDb() {
  if (pastPapersDb.length > 0) return pastPapersDb;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('past_papers_metadata.json');
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
    pastPapersDb = await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load past papers metadata:', error);
  }
  return pastPapersDb;
}

function populateYearDropdown(db) {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  if (!yearSelect) return;

  const years = new Set();
  db.forEach(item => {
    if (item.year) {
      years.add(item.year.toString().trim());
    }
  });

  const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));

  yearSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Years</option>';
  sortedYears.forEach(year => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearSelect.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function renderTableData() {
  const tableBody = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-body');
  const paginationContainer = document.getElementById('pagination-controls');
  if (!tableBody) return;

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredExams.length / pageSize);
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = Math.max(1, totalPages);

  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
  const end = start + pageSize;
  const pageItems = filteredExams.slice(start, end);

  let html = '';
  pageItems.forEach(exam => {
    const seasonLabel = exam.session.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + exam.session.slice(1);
    const paperLabel = exam.paper.toUpperCase();
    const subjectLabel = exam.subject_code.toUpperCase();
    
    // Tier Badge styling
    let tierBadge = '';
    if (exam.tier === 'h') {
      tierBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1); color: #8b5cf6; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">Higher</span>`;
    } else if (exam.tier === 'f') {
      tierBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #3b82f6; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">Foundation</span>`;
    } else {
      tierBadge = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">—</span>`;
    }

    // Variant Badge
    let variantBadge = '';
    if (exam.variant === 'r') {
      variantBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #d97706; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">R</span>`;
    } else {
      variantBadge = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">—</span>`;
    }

    let qpHtml = '';
    if (exam.qp) {
      qpHtml = `<a href="${exam.qp}" target="_blank" title="Download Question Paper" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary bi bi-file-earmark-text" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      qpHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    let msHtml = '';
    if (exam.ms) {
      msHtml = `<a href="${exam.ms}" target="_blank" title="Download Mark Scheme" class="btn btn-sm btn-success bi bi-key" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      msHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${exam.year}</strong></td>
        <td><strong>${seasonLabel}</strong></td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">${subjectLabel}</span></td>
        <td>${tierBadge}</td>
        <td>${variantBadge}</td>
        <td><span class="badge" style="background: rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.1); color: #4b5563; border: 1px solid rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.2); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;">${paperLabel}</span></td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${qpHtml}</td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${msHtml}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });
  tableBody.innerHTML = html;

  if (totalPages <= 1) {
    paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  let pagHtml = '';
  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage - 1})">Prev</button>`;
  
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (i === currentPage) {
      pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary active">${i}</button>`;
    } else {
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - currentPage) <= 1) {
        pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
      } else if (i === 2 || i === totalPages - 1) {
        pagHtml += `<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>`;
      }
    }
  }

  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage + 1})">Next</button>`;
  
  paginationContainer.innerHTML = pagHtml.replace(/(<span class="text-muted px-1">\.\.\.<\/span>\s*){2,}/g, '<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>');
}

function changePage(page) {
  currentPage = page;
  renderTableData();
  document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
}

function applyFilters() {
  let filtered = pastPapersDb;

  if (currentSelectedYear) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.year.toString() === currentSelectedYear);
  }
  if (currentSelectedSubject) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.subject_code.startsWith(currentSelectedSubject));
  }
  if (currentSelectedTier) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.tier === currentSelectedTier);
  }
  if (currentSelectedPaper) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.paper === currentSelectedPaper);
  }

  const exams = {};
  filtered.forEach(item => {
    const key = `${item.year}_${item.session}_${item.subject_code}_${item.tier}_${item.variant}_${item.paper}`;
    if (!exams[key]) {
      exams[key] = {
        year: item.year,
        session: item.session,
        subject_code: item.subject_code,
        tier: item.tier,
        variant: item.variant,
        paper: item.paper,
        qp: null,
        ms: null
      };
    }
    if (item.type === 'qp') {
      exams[key].qp = item.link;
    } else if (item.type === 'ms') {
      exams[key].ms = item.link;
    }
  });

  filteredExams = Object.values(exams);
  filteredExams.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.year !== b.year) return parseInt(b.year) - parseInt(a.year);
    if (a.session !== b.session) return b.session.localeCompare(a.session);
    if (a.subject_code !== b.subject_code) return a.subject_code.localeCompare(b.subject_code);
    return a.paper.localeCompare(b.paper);
  });

  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  if (filteredExams.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #9ca3af;"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> No matching past papers found.</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="table-wrapper">
      <table class="premium-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Year</th>
            <th>Session</th>
            <th>Subject</th>
            <th>Tier</th>
            <th>Variant</th>
            <th>Paper</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">QP</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">MS</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="past-papers-table-body">
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center gap-2 mt-3" id="pagination-controls"></div>
  `;

  currentPage = 1;
  renderTableData();
}

function selectYearDropdown() {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  currentSelectedYear = yearSelect.value || '';
  applyFilters();
}

function selectSubject(button) {
  currentSelectedSubject = button.getAttribute('data-subject') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-subject-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

// Keep selectTier, selectPaper, initPastPapersTable, and event listener unchanged.
function selectTier(button) {
  currentSelectedTier = button.getAttribute('data-tier') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-tier-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

function selectPaper(button) {
  currentSelectedPaper = button.getAttribute('data-paper') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-paper-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

async function initPastPapersTable() {
  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  const db = await loadPastPapersDb();
  
  if (!db || db.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color: #ef4444;"></i> Error: Failed to load past papers database. Please try again later.</p>';
    return;
  }

  populateYearDropdown(db);
  applyFilters();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initPastPapersTable();
});
</script>
```
